_help: Short notices at the top of the site. Each one shows from start to end (both YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) and then disappears by itself. type is one of: hours, popup, stock, info. Notices can NOT open or close the shop: use status.json for that.

notices.body_en: Closed on Midsummer Eve. Happy Midsummer!

notices.body_fi: Varaa juhlapaisti tai lahjalaatikko ajoissa: määrät ovat rajalliset.
notices.body_en: Reserve your holiday roast or gift box early: quantities are limited.
Holiday opening hours are listed on the Contact page.
